# Grampians Peaks Trail 100 Miler — Pairs

| | |
|---|---|
| **Event** | GPT100 Miler — Pairs Category |
| **Date** | Friday 6 November 2026, 8:00am |
| **Distance** | 162km |
| **Elevation** | 7,544m gain / 7,557m loss |
| **Course** | Mt Zero Picnic Area → Dunkeld (point-to-point) |
| **Total Cutoff** | 50 hours (finish by Sunday 10:00am) |
| **Target Finish** | 42-44 hours (conservative with buffer) |
| **Training Start** | Week of 18 May 2026 |
| **Weeks to Race** | ~25 weeks |

---

## Key Medical Protocols for Race Day
- **Fuelling:** Eat every 30-45 mins regardless of hunger (Vyvanse suppresses appetite)
- **Sodium:** 500-1000mg/hour from AS5 onwards, drink to thirst not schedule
- **Heat:** Z1-Z2 only (115-142 bpm) when temp exceeds 28C — Legs 1-3 may be hot
- **Night legs:** Lights, warmth layers, sodium vigilance from AS5 onwards
- **Symbicort:** Pre-dose before cold morning sections (AS6 dawn, AS11 dawn)

**Target finish time: ~45.5 hours** (conservative, ~4hr buffer to cutoff)

*Pairs note: these targets include buffer for pair dynamics. Do not chase faster times early — bank time in legs 1-5 to spend on legs 6-8.*

## Section Difficulty Rating

| Section | Gain | Rating | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Start → AS1 | 620m | ★★★☆☆ | Flat Rock opening climb |
| AS1 → AS2 | 1100m | ★★★★★ | THE DOOZY. Long exposed climb |
| AS2 → AS3 | 300m | ★★★☆☆ | Faster, descent to Halls Gap |
| AS3 → AS4 | 650m | ★★★★☆ | Pinnacles, technical rocky |
| AS4 → AS5 | 440m | ★★★☆☆ | Flowy 8km descent — best running |
| AS5 → AS6 | **1260m** | ★★★★★ | THE CRUX. Night. Seven Dials + Redmans + Mt William |
| AS6 → AS7 | 775m | ★★★★★ | Durd Durd 1167m. 1400m descent. Longest leg |
| AS7 → AS8 | 580m | ★★★☆☆ | Beautiful valley, recoverable |
| AS8 → AS9 | 440m | ★★★☆☆ | New trails, boardwalks |
| AS9 → AS10 | 450m | ★★★☆☆ | Rolling, manageable |
| AS10 → AS11 | **650m** | ★★★★☆ | Signal Peak + Mt Abrupt. Hurt legs |
| AS11 → Finish | 455m | ★★★☆☆ | Mt Sturgeon then 6km to line |

**Key: Save legs for AS5-AS7. That 34km section with 2035m gain/loss will make or break the race.**

**High point: 1167m (Durd Durd, ~km 100)**
**Coldest point: AS6 Mt William 1068m (~5am Sat)**

options.content:
## Race Day HR Pacing — GPT100

Based on Little River 2025 (106.8km, 19.9hrs) — GOLD STANDARD reference.
Actual: Z1 29%, Z2 52%, Z3 18%, Z4 1%, Z5 0%

### GPT100 Target Distribution

| Zone | BPM | Target % | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| Z1 | 115-129 | **35%** | Climbs, night, recovery sections |
| Z2 | 129-142 | **50%** | Primary race effort |
| Z3 | 142-156 | **13%** | Short climbs only |
| Z4 | 156-169 | **2%** | Absolute maximum |
| Z5 | 169-183 | **0%** | Never in a 162km race |

**Target avg HR: 110-120 bpm** (similar to Little River 109 avg)

**Red flags during race:**
- HR > 145 sustained on flat = too fast, slow down
- HR > 155 on any climb = walk it
- HR < 100 + feeling terrible = check sodium (hyponatraemia risk)
- HR unusually low + nausea = stop and assess
